Description

About the role:

Qatar Airways are pleased to announce an incredibly exciting opportunity to join our Flight Operations - Operational Strategy & Innovation team as a Senior Data Science Analyst to be based in Doha, Qatar.

As a Senior Data Science Analyst, will apply advanced analytical techniques to enhance the efficiency of Flight Operations and Technical Operations (CAMO). This role involves leveraging a wide range of methodologies, including machine learning, optimization, root cause analysis, and prototyping decision-support tools. The successful candidate will deliver actionable insights and provide strategic recommendations to senior management and business stakeholders.

Specific responsibilities for the role include:

  • Use a combined knowledge of data science, statistics, machine learning and optimization techniques to enhance Flight Operations and Technical Operations (CAMO) analytics capabilities.

  • Develop and maintain strong business acumen within the Flight Operations and Technical Operations (CAMO) analytical scope, especially in the areas of on-time performance, flight schedule, predictive maintenance and impact on operational costs.

  • Responsible for delivering multiple, highly complex and advanced analyses in a timely, efficient manner in collaboration with Flight and technical Operations teams to understand contextual problems and deliver innovative solutions that address business needs.

  • Lead data analysis activities using available sources to identify trends and patterns, deliver deeper operational insights to make predictions and generate data-driven recommendations.

  • Develop and deploy machine learning and optimization models.

  • Propose and develop data-driven support prototypes based on machine learning and Optimization for further evaluation by the business users.

  • Leverage emerging tools, open-source frameworks, and cloud technologies (including Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and Databricks) to create predictive and prescriptive analytics solutions. Familiarity with the Skywise platform is considered a plus.

Qualification

About you

The successful candidate will have the following skills and qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Operations Research, Artificial Intelligence.

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and minimum 3 years’ experience in Data Science role.

  • Experience in applying statistics, advanced analytical methods, and operations research to solve business problems.

  • Excellent presentation skills and data visualization.

  • Proficiency in Python, R, and SQL for data preparation, querying, and ML model development.

  • Hands-on experience with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras.

  • Experience in Optimization software tools such as Cplex, Gurobi, Google OR-Tools.

  • Advanced level of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint. Outlook) skills.

  • Experience with top-tier BI tools such as Qlik, Power BI, Tableau.

  • Experience with the Skywise platform will be considered an asset.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of partners, senior managers, and subject matter experts.

  • Any certification in Data Science or Machine learning using any cloud platform is considered an asset.
